examples.verified_fact: Since the July 2024 methodology change, Ofcom considers average download-speed analysis robust to local-authority level, not postcode level.
examples.allowed_use: Keep postcode rows as coverage proxies and leave performance/parcel scores null
examples.forbidden_use: Do not infer postcode or parcel measured speed from Connected Nations performance analysis.

examples.source: Ofcom Spring 2026 fixed coverage V2 schema
examples.verified_fact: Ofcom corrected the CW file that duplicated CV and the MK file that duplicated ME, then renamed all 121 all-premises postcode files from r1 to r2.
examples.allowed_use: Require r2 names and verify CW!=CV and MK!=ME by SHA-256 before any join
examples.forbidden_use: Do not accept the superseded r1 postcode files or a package retaining either duplicate defect.

examples.source: Ofcom Spring 2026 fixed coverage V2 schema
examples.verified_fact: The postcode field has spaces removed and postcode_space uses one space before the inward code.
examples.allowed_use: Require exact UK postcode syntax, exact one-space postcode_space formatting and matching normalized values
examples.forbidden_use: Do not silently accept malformed spacing or conflicting postcode identifiers.

examples.source: Ofcom Spring 2026 fixed coverage V2 schema
examples.verified_fact: SFBB, UFBB and gigabit fields are availability percentages; the unable-to-receive-30 field is defined for matched premises, while unable-to-receive-decent fixed-or-FWA includes unmatched and zero-speed records.
examples.allowed_use: Preserve the documented denominator for each metric in validation/readback metadata
examples.forbidden_use: Do not treat unable-30 as the exact complement of SFBB or mix the two denominators.

examples.source: Ofcom Spring 2026 fixed coverage V2 schema
examples.verified_fact: Postcode and output-area files contain gigabit-capable coverage but not full-fibre coverage due to commercial confidentiality; coverage is fixed-line except fields explicitly referring to FWA.
examples.allowed_use: Reject unexpected postcode-level full-fibre columns and label explicit FWA fields separately
examples.forbidden_use: Do not infer postcode full-fibre availability or describe every field as fixed-plus-FWA coverage.
